say:1:1720823001:1.text: Where's the shipping manifest?! The ship to Whiteridge is about to depart, we need those crates sealed!
say:1:1720823001:1.source_cn: 这批货的运货单怎么还没到？去白山公国的船待会就要出发，...

say:4:1720823003:1.text: Let me see... Whiteridge, Zadrinford... yeah, this is it!
say:4:1720823003:1.source_cn: 运货单？我看看……白山公国，兹达尔镇……没错，就是这张！
say:4:1720823003:1.male: Let me see... Whiteridge, Zadrinford... yeah, this is it!
say:4:1720823003:1.female: Let me see... Whiteridge, Zadrinford... yeah, this is it!

say:5:1720823004:1.text: Pick up the pace, everyone! Seal the cargo! Load everything, now!
say:5:1720823004:1.source_cn: 快快快，运货单到了，把货物封箱！赶紧运上船！
say:5:1720823004:1.male: Pick up the pace, everyone! Seal the cargo! Load everything, now!
say:5:1720823004:1.female: Pick up the pace, everyone! Seal the cargo! Load everything, now!

narration:6:1720823005:1.text: Dockworkers bustle about, sealing crates and hauling cargo in a noisy flurry.

narration:7:1720823006:1.text: Only after all the cargo is loaded does Krav notice you two are still there.
narration:7:1720823006:1.male: Only after all the cargo is loaded does Krav notice you two are still there.
narration:7:1720823006:1.female: Only after all the cargo is loaded does Krav notice you two are still there.

say:9:1720823007:1.text: Sorry about that. Did the boss send you for anything else?
say:9:1720823007:1.source_cn: 对不住对不住，忙着运货，刚刚没顾得上你们。是老板还有什...

say:11:1720823009:1.text: Hey! Remember me, from the Steel Doves!
say:11:1720823009:1.source_cn: 嘿，维伦！还记得我吗，克拉瓦！鸽子窝的克拉瓦！

say:12:1720823010:1.text: Of course I remember. C'mere, you remember our special greeting?
say:12:1720823010:1.source_cn: 当然，我怎么会忘呢。还记得我们专属的打招呼方式吗？

say:13:1720823011:3.text: They raise their right arms in unison. After a flashy sequence, their fists bump together.
say:13:1720823011:3.source_cn: 两人同时娴熟地抬起右臂。一套花哨的招呼后，两只拳头碰到...

say:14:1720823012:1.text: The distance created by years apart seems to vanish with that single gesture.
say:14:1720823012:1.source_cn: 多年不见产生的隔阂，似乎也在这次碰拳中悄无声息地消失了。

say:15:1720823013:1.text: What brings you back? Things not working out with the Order?
say:15:1720823013:1.source_cn: 维伦，你怎么突然回来了？是不是在骑士团里呆的不开心？

say:16:1720823014:1.text: If you're unhappy, just say the word. Come back and work with us. The boss you set me up with is a really good guy. Sure, there's a lot to do, but he always pays on time—
say:16:1720823014:1.source_cn: 不舒服就说，回来跟我们一起干。你当时介绍的老板人真不错...

say:17:1720823015:1.text: ...Wait, why are you delivering the manifest? Does that mean you're coming to work for him?
say:17:1720823015:1.source_cn: ……呃，刚才忘了问，怎么是你来送运货单？难道你已经回来...

choice_prompt:18:1720823015.text: ...Wait, why are you delivering the manifest? Does that mean you're coming to work for him?
choice_prompt:18:1720823015.source_cn: ……呃，刚才忘了问，怎么是你来送运货单？难道你已经回来跟着老板干了？

say:19:1720823016:2.text: You explain as best as you can, without revealing the Solitaries' existence.
say:19:1720823016:2.source_cn: 你尽量用不暴露隐士存在的方式向克拉瓦讲述了前因后果。
say:19:1720823016:2.male: You explain as best as you can, without revealing the Solitaries' existence.
say:19:1720823016:2.female: You explain as best as you can, without revealing the Solitaries' existence.

say:20:1720823017:1.text: The key point is you're delivering the manifest as part of a deal to learn about Valen's past.
say:20:1720823017:1.source_cn: 重点在于，你之所以来帮忙送运货单，是因为要通过交易打听...
say:20:1720823017:1.male: The key point is you're delivering the manifest as part of a deal to learn about Valen's past.
say:20:1720823017:1.female: The key point is you're delivering the manifest as part of a deal to learn about Valen's past.

say:21:1720823018:1.text: ... But he's standing right here. Why not just ask him? And is delivering this the task for the deal?
say:21:1720823018:1.source_cn: 呃……可他明明就站在这里啊，直接向他问不就得了？还有，...
say:21:1720823018:1.male: ... But he's standing right here. Why not just ask him? And is delivering this the task for the deal?
say:21:1720823018:1.female: ... But he's standing right here. Why not just ask him? And is delivering this the task for the deal?

choice_prompt:22:1720823018.text: ... But he's standing right here. Why not just ask him? And is delivering this the task for the deal?
choice_prompt:22:1720823018.source_cn: 呃……可他明明就站在这里啊，直接向他问不就得了？还有，为什么交易的内容是帮我送货运单？
choice_prompt:22:1720823018.male: ... But he's standing right here. Why not just ask him? And is delivering this the task for the deal?
choice_prompt:22:1720823018.female: ... But he's standing right here. Why not just ask him? And is delivering this the task for the deal?

say:23:1720823019:1.text: What can I say? It's the boss' orders.
say:23:1720823019:1.source_cn: 没办法，这是老板的意思。
say:23:1720823019:1.male: What can I say? It's the boss' orders.
say:23:1720823019:1.female: What can I say? It's the boss' orders.

say:24:1720823021:1.text: Alright... I don't really get what's going on, but thanks for delivering it.
say:24:1720823021:1.source_cn: 好吧，虽然不知道你们两个什么情况……反正，多谢你们帮忙...
say:24:1720823021:1.male: Alright... I don't really get what's going on, but thanks for delivering it.
say:24:1720823021:1.female: Alright... I don't really get what's going on, but thanks for delivering it.

say:26:1720823022:0.text: You want to know Valen's past? You didn't need a deal for that. I know plenty about this guy's history.
say:26:1720823022:0.source_cn: 不过，你要问维伦的过去？那不用跟老板交易也行，关于这家...
say:26:1720823022:0.male: You want to know Valen's past? You didn't need a deal for that. I know plenty about this guy's history.
say:26:1720823022:0.female: You want to know Valen's past? You didn't need a deal for that. I know plenty about this guy's history.

say:27:1720823023:1.text: After all, we raised hell together in Savannah, back in the day!
say:27:1720823023:1.source_cn: 毕竟，之前我们可是一起大闹过赛凡纳啊！
say:27:1720823023:1.male: After all, we raised hell together in Savannah, back in the day!
say:27:1720823023:1.female: After all, we raised hell together in Savannah, back in the day!

say:28:1720823024:1.text: That was over ten years ago. We weren't even adults yet.
say:28:1720823024:1.source_cn: 得是十多年前的事了吧，那时候我们还没成年，只有现在一半...
say:28:1720823024:1.male: That was over ten years ago. We weren't even adults yet.
say:28:1720823024:1.female: That was over ten years ago. We weren't even adults yet.

say:29:1720823025:1.text: A few years after the Second Divine War, people were finally recovering. Especially in Savannah. Everywhere was so lively and prosperous, you'd never guess a war had happened.
say:29:1720823025:1.source_cn: 第二次神魔大战结束几年后，人们也从战争中缓了过来。尤其...
say:29:1720823025:1.male: A few years after the Second Divine War, people were finally recovering. Especially in Savannah. Everywhere was so lively and prosperous, you'd never guess a war had happened.
say:29:1720823025:1.female: A few years after the Second Divine War, people were finally recovering. Especially in Savannah. Everywhere was so lively and prosperous, you'd never guess a war had happened.

say:30:1720823026:1.text: Those nobles and rich folk were all scrambling to move forward. Desperate to leave everything about the war behind.
say:30:1720823026:1.source_cn: 那群贵族和有钱老爷，各个都忙着使劲往前走。急着要把那些...
say:30:1720823026:1.male: Those nobles and rich folk were all scrambling to move forward. Desperate to leave everything about the war behind.
say:30:1720823026:1.female: Those nobles and rich folk were all scrambling to move forward. Desperate to leave everything about the war behind.

say:31:1720823027:1.text: Only the dead and those who remembered them were left behind.
say:31:1720823027:1.source_cn: 就只剩下那些死人，还有记着那群死人的人，还被留在原地。
say:31:1720823027:1.male: Only the dead and those who remembered them were left behind.
say:31:1720823027:1.female: Only the dead and those who remembered them were left behind.

say:32:1720823028:1.text: Like me and Valen. We were war orphans.
say:32:1720823028:1.source_cn: 就比如说我和维伦。我们都是第二次神魔大战时期的孤儿。
say:32:1720823028:1.male: Like me and Valen. We were war orphans.
say:32:1720823028:1.female: Like me and Valen. We were war orphans.

say:33:1720823029:1.text: The Empire handed out compensation, sure, but how much money was distributed, and how much actually reached us... They didn't know, and they didn't care. Probably lining someone's pockets.
say:33:1720823029:1.source_cn: 王国发下了抚恤金，但关于这笔钱发下来的过程，以及最后到...
say:33:1720823029:1.male: The Empire handed out compensation, sure, but how much money was distributed, and how much actually reached us... They didn't know, and they didn't care. Probably lining someone's pockets.
say:33:1720823029:1.female: The Empire handed out compensation, sure, but how much money was distributed, and how much actually reached us... They didn't know, and they didn't care. Probably lining someone's pockets.

say:34:1720823030:1.text: We couldn't even afford an apprenticeship fee to learn a trade. We'd wander the alleys, starving. And when we did find work, it was always the dangerous kind.
say:34:1720823030:1.source_cn: 交不上学徒费，连学门手艺都不行。我们饿着肚子在巷子里乱...
say:34:1720823030:1.male: We couldn't even afford an apprenticeship fee to learn a trade. We'd wander the alleys, starving. And when we did find work, it was always the dangerous kind.
say:34:1720823030:1.female: We couldn't even afford an apprenticeship fee to learn a trade. We'd wander the alleys, starving. And when we did find work, it was always the dangerous kind.

say:35:1720823031:1.text: That's when Valen stepped in. He pulled us together. We took jobs as a group, watching each other's backs.
say:35:1720823031:1.source_cn: 是维伦帮了我们。他把我们这群人集结起来，每天一起接活，...
say:35:1720823031:1.male: That's when Valen stepped in. He pulled us together. We took jobs as a group, watching each other's backs.
say:35:1720823031:1.female: That's when Valen stepped in. He pulled us together. We took jobs as a group, watching each other's backs.

say:36:1720823032:1.text: If the guards or the Order showed up, we'd tip each other off. And if there was no work, he'd win a few rounds of cards and buy food to share with everyone.
say:36:1720823032:1.source_cn: 要是有哪天接不到活，他就靠打牌去挣钱，买回吃的和我们分着吃。
say:36:1720823032:1.male: If the guards or the Order showed up, we'd tip each other off. And if there was no work, he'd win a few rounds of cards and buy food to share with everyone.
say:36:1720823032:1.female: If the guards or the Order showed up, we'd tip each other off. And if there was no work, he'd win a few rounds of cards and buy food to share with everyone.

say:37:1720823033:1.text: That was the "Steel Doves". Valen always said it was just a loose group, people sticking together to get by. But to us... it felt like family.
say:37:1720823033:1.source_cn: 这就是“鸽子窝”。虽然维伦一直说这就是个抱团取暖的松散...
say:37:1720823033:1.male: That was the "Steel Doves". Valen always said it was just a loose group, people sticking together to get by. But to us... it felt like family.
say:37:1720823033:1.female: That was the "Steel Doves". Valen always said it was just a loose group, people sticking together to get by. But to us... it felt like family.

say:38:1720823034:1.text: Eventually we grew up. People started leaving to find their own paths. The Steel Doves disbanded, but I didn't want to leave. I wanted to stick with Valen, keep living like we used to.
say:38:1720823034:1.source_cn: 后来我们成年了，陆陆续续不少人离开各寻出路，“鸽子窝”...
say:38:1720823034:1.male: Eventually we grew up. People started leaving to find their own paths. The Steel Doves disbanded, but I didn't want to leave. I wanted to stick with Valen, keep living like we used to.
say:38:1720823034:1.female: Eventually we grew up. People started leaving to find their own paths. The Steel Doves disbanded, but I didn't want to leave. I wanted to stick with Valen, keep living like we used to.

choice_prompt:39:1720823034.text: Eventually we grew up. People started leaving to find their own paths. The Steel Doves disbanded, but I didn't want to leave. I wanted to stick with Valen, keep living like we used to.
choice_prompt:39:1720823034.source_cn: 后来我们成年了，陆陆续续不少人离开各寻出路，“鸽子窝”也就解散了。可我不愿意走，我就想跟着维伦，过以前的日子。
choice_prompt:39:1720823034.male: Eventually we grew up. People started leaving to find their own paths. The Steel Doves disbanded, but I didn't want to leave. I wanted to stick with Valen, keep living like we used to.
choice_prompt:39:1720823034.female: Eventually we grew up. People started leaving to find their own paths. The Steel Doves disbanded, but I didn't want to leave. I wanted to stick with Valen, keep living like we used to.

say:40:1720823035:1.text: Yeah. That's when they finally caught him.
say:40:1720823035:1.source_cn: 是啊，那次他被骑士团的人抓了。
say:40:1720823035:1.male: Yeah. That's when they finally caught him.
say:40:1720823035:1.female: Yeah. That's when they finally caught him.

say:41:1720823036:1.text: I still can't believe it. Whoever managed it must've been something else. With Valen's skills, he was harder to catch than a fish slipping through your fingers!
say:41:1720823036:1.source_cn: 说起来，那人还真厉害，居然能抓住维伦！凭他那一身本事，...
say:41:1720823036:1.male: I still can't believe it. Whoever managed it must've been something else. With Valen's skills, he was harder to catch than a fish slipping through your fingers!
say:41:1720823036:1.female: I still can't believe it. Whoever managed it must've been something else. With Valen's skills, he was harder to catch than a fish slipping through your fingers!

say:43:1720823037:0.text: Let me stop you right there. Could you maybe use a slightly more flattering metaphor?
say:43:1720823037:0.source_cn: 打断一下，我说朋友，能不能换个优雅点的比喻？

say:44:1720823038:1.text: Anyways. When I heard he joined the Order, I felt betrayed.
say:44:1720823038:1.source_cn: 知道维伦加入骑士团时，我感觉自己被背叛了。
say:44:1720823038:1.male: Anyways. When I heard he joined the Order, I felt betrayed.
say:44:1720823038:1.female: Anyways. When I heard he joined the Order, I felt betrayed.

say:45:1720823039:1.text: Back then, we all looked down on the knights. They couldn't protect our families during the war, yet they somehow had all the time in the world to chase after us. I hated them.
say:45:1720823039:1.source_cn: 那时我们都看不起骑士团的人。这些人没能在战争中保护我们...
say:45:1720823039:1.male: Back then, we all looked down on the knights. They couldn't protect our families during the war, yet they somehow had all the time in the world to chase after us. I hated them.
say:45:1720823039:1.female: Back then, we all looked down on the knights. They couldn't protect our families during the war, yet they somehow had all the time in the world to chase after us. I hated them.

say:46:1720823040:1.text: Valen asked me to go with him. I said no. I threw every insult I had at him... and said things I can't take back.
say:46:1720823040:1.source_cn: 当时维伦让我和他一起走，我没同意，还骂了他一顿。骂得很...
say:46:1720823040:1.male: Valen asked me to go with him. I said no. I threw every insult I had at him... and said things I can't take back.
say:46:1720823040:1.female: Valen asked me to go with him. I said no. I threw every insult I had at him... and said things I can't take back.

say:47:1720823041:1.text: It's all in the past. Don't worry about it.

choice_prompt:48:1720823041.text: It's all in the past. Don't worry about it.

say:49:1720823042:2.text: He never argued back. He just handed me a note before he left. It said if I ever wanted honest work, I should go to that address.
say:49:1720823042:2.source_cn: 我骂他，他一句话没说，只是在走的时候留下来了一张纸条。...
say:49:1720823042:2.male: He never argued back. He just handed me a note before he left. It said if I ever wanted honest work, I should go to that address.
say:49:1720823042:2.female: He never argued back. He just handed me a note before he left. It said if I ever wanted honest work, I should go to that address.

say:50:1720823043:1.text: That's how I found my current boss. I've never met him face to face, but the pay's good. Better than anything I ever dreamed of.
say:50:1720823043:1.source_cn: 我去了，就找到了现在的老板。虽然没见过老板本人，但工作...
say:50:1720823043:1.male: That's how I found my current boss. I've never met him face to face, but the pay's good. Better than anything I ever dreamed of.
say:50:1720823043:1.female: That's how I found my current boss. I've never met him face to face, but the pay's good. Better than anything I ever dreamed of.

say:51:1720823044:1.text: Valen... I couldn't find you after that. I never thought I'd see you again. I always wanted to say... thank you. And I'm sorry.
say:51:1720823044:1.source_cn: 维伦，我一直没能联系上你，真没想到还能再见你一面。我一...

say:52:1720823045:1.text: Hey, Krav, you doing alright these days?
say:52:1720823045:1.source_cn: 嘿，克拉瓦，你现在过得还好吗？

say:53:1720823046:0.source_cn: 一切都好，维伦。一切都好。

say:54:1720823047:0.text: Same here. That's all I needed to hear.

say:55:1720823048:0.text: We should grab a drink at the Rusty Barrel Tavern sometime. Until next time, Krav.
say:55:1720823048:0.source_cn: 有空一起去锈桶酒馆喝酒。下次见，克拉瓦。

say:57:1720823050:3.text: The cargo ship rumbles as it pulls away toward the horizon. Two fists bump, then part. Just like that, they go their separate ways again.
say:57:1720823050:3.source_cn: 开向远方的货船轰鸣。两只拳头相碰，然后分开。

choice:48:1:2.text: What did you do when he left?
choice:48:1:2.male: What did you do when he left?
choice:48:1:2.female: What did you do when he left?

choice:39:0:1.text: But then Valen joined the Heroic Order...
choice:39:0:1.source_cn: 但后来维伦加入了骑士团……
choice:39:0:1.male: But then Valen joined the Heroic Order...
choice:39:0:1.female: But then Valen joined the Heroic Order...

say:59:1720823020:0.text: Hey, it's the boss' idea! He has a weird sense of humor.
say:59:1720823020:0.source_cn: 容我补充，这也是老板的主意。
say:59:1720823020:0.male: Hey, it's the boss' idea! He has a weird sense of humor.
say:59:1720823020:0.female: Hey, it's the boss' idea! He has a weird sense of humor.

choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 我们就是来送运货单的！
